**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear description of the elderly care problem or caregiving challenge (e.g. "Medication cabinet tracking is needed").

**Which sensors / hardware would be supported?**
(e.g. Aqara FP2 mmWave radar, Zigbee contact sensor, smart bed presence sensor).

**Alternative approaches considered**
Any existing Home Assistant automations or community gists evaluated.
